note: Approved campaign artwork for the homepage campaign stage. Source of truth: Google Drive / Masinloc Website Asset / Ads. The artwork is finished design: it already carries its own logo, headline, copy and layout, so it is never cropped hard, never has type laid over it, and is never regenerated. scripts/build-campaigns.py derives the responsive sizes; scripts/check-photography.py refuses to serve any campaign not listed here.
rules: Never invent a campaign when approved artwork exists.
Never redesign approved artwork, and never alter embedded logos, copy, typography or branding.
Never crop away embedded copy. The whole artwork stays visible at every width.
A mobile source is used only when the project supplies one. No portrait variant is ever fabricated.
